origin.description: The default method is base order. Ties keep their original order. decreasing = TRUE still leaves missing values where na.last puts them. Signed zero ties with zero.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object. A zoo series stores observations separately from its index.

arguments.name: na.last
arguments.text: TRUE puts missing values last, FALSE puts them first, and NA drops them.

arguments.name: decreasing
arguments.text: TRUE reverses the order. One value applies to every key.
